messages:
mike (infra): Quick proposal — introduce an observability contract for GPU cluster structured logs. Goal: consistent fields + default PII redaction + sampling QoS so we keep SLO fidelity but cut storage/cost. Thoughts? :eyes:

adele (observability): +1 on a contract. We need per-stream sampling labels and a lightweight qos field to indicate retention priority. Also a canonical request_id and model_id. Short note: avoid dumping full prompts in logs. :thumbsup:

sophie (privacy): Strongly agree. Suggest automatic pii_masked boolean and redaction_version. Any free-text fields must go through the redact pipeline stage. Default sampling for raw_prompt in prod should be 1%.

mike (infra): Sketch of a minimal schema (very compact):
```json
{
  "ts": "2026-03-10T12:23:00Z",
  "request_id": "r-abc123",
  "model": "redwood/gptx-3b",
  "qos": "high",
  "pii_masked": true,
  "redaction_version": "v1",
  "msg_type": "generation",
  "payload_summary": "token_count=42,first_tokens_hash=sha256:...",
  "size_bytes": 1234
}
```

stanley (sre): Map qos->retention+alerting. Proposal: high -> 30d raw, medium -> 7d aggregated, low -> 24h raw then compact. Also alerts: if qos=high ingested qps spikes > X in region -> page.

adele (observability): Sampling rules idea: sample_rate = base_rate * qos_multiplier. e.g., base=0.01, qos multipliers: high=1, medium=0.1, low=0.01. Add sample_policy labels: prefix_cache | burst | periodic.

mike (infra): Cost back-of-envelope: reducing raw ingress by ~70% could save ~$45k/month across GPU fleet. We'll need finance sign-off but good leverage for this.

sophie (privacy): Also add a consent field: user_consent = true|false|unknown. If false -> drop raw_prompt entirely and store only summary hash and minimal metadata.

adele (observability): Dashboard changes: add per-region panels for log_ingest_rate, sampled_ratio, retention_burn. Also add logs.sampled_ratio metric with labels region,qos,msg_type. Alert tuning: fire when sampled_ratio < expected for >10m or retention_burn > 90% for 6h.

stanley (sre): Can we canary this in us-west-2 for ~2% of cluster for 2 weeks? Need automated fallback: if error budget burn > threshold, switch sample_policy to full for 1h across canary nodes.

mike (infra): Plan: RFC PR -> canary -> staged rollouts -> enforcement. I'll open the RFC today. @adele can you prepare dashboard diffs? @sophie can you sign privacy rules?

adele (observability): On it. Will paste grafana JSON diffs in the RFC and include example queries.

sophie (privacy): Will review. One ask: add audit log entries whenever redaction_version or sampling policy changes — necessary for compliance.

ci-bot: Deploy preview for schema branch is available: https://ci.internal/observability/changes/34 :white_check_mark:

mike (infra): One small rule: keep schema backward compatible — new fields optional and default pii_masked=false unless pipeline sets it.

stanley (sre): Ack. I'll update the alert runbooks and test the fallback automation.

adele (observability): Suggest using a single metric name logs.sampled_ratio with labels (region,qos,msg_type) so we can drive templated dashboards.

mike (infra): Timeline: RFC by EOD Wed, canary next Mon. Thanks all.
